title: Qualiance International IPO Details
intro:
Qualiance International IPO is a book build issue of ₹45.11 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 35.52 lakh shares of ₹45.11 crore.

Qualiance International IPO opens for subscription on Sep 4, 2026 and closes on Sep 8, 2026. The allotment for the Qualiance International IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 9, 2026. Qualiance International IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 11, 2026.

Qualiance International IPO is set issue price band at ₹120 to ₹127 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,54,000 (2,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,81,000.

Hem Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Qualiance International IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Qualiance International Limited is engaged in the design, engineering, manufacture and export of performance garments for institutional, government and brand clients in international markets.

The company product portfolio includes military uniforms, tactical outerwear, high-visibility workwear, weather-resistant and all-weather outerwear, police and border patrol uniforms, protective workwear and performance activewear.

The company operate a manufacturing facility located in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu with a total built up area of over 45,000 square feet over a land area of approximately 1,046.31 square meters and an installed capacity of 450,000 garment pieces per annum.
They have manufactured garments based on product specifications and compliance requirements of European military, government and institutional buyers.
strengths: In-house manufacturing facility with quality control mechanism
Integrated expertise in high performance technical garments

The minimum order quantity is 1000 . The IPO opens on Fri, Sep 4, 2026 , and closes on Tue, Sep 8, 2026 . MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar for the IPO . The shares are proposed to be listed on NSE SME .

faqs.question: How to apply in Qualiance International IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Qualiance International IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Qualiance International IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Qualiance International IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Qualiance International IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Qualiance International IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Qualiance International IPO opens on Fri, Sep 4, 2026 and closes on Tue, Sep 8, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Qualiance International IPO?
faqs.answer: Qualiance International IPO lot size is 1000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,54,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Qualiance International IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Qualiance International IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Qualiance International IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Qualiance International IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Sep 10, 2026 . Check the Qualiance International IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Qualiance International IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Qualiance International IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Sep 11, 2026 .
